instruction: Make the title text on slide 4 bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to single-slide, single-property task (bold on slide 4) to test basic text formatting capability in a different way than color/underline
metadata.explanation: Task requires making the title text on slide 4 bold. Getter finds the title shape (largest font) on slide 4 and checks bold status. Metric verifies all runs are bold with partial credit.
